title: Mixed Event — First Star After the Rain — Episode1 Alone in the Rain

meta.Event Outline: Saki has formed a band with her childhood friends and is enjoying what each day brings. She happens upon a poster for an observatory event one day and decides to plan a visit with her bandmates, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ngh...
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I didn't realize I fell asleep. Ugh, my neck hurts. I must have slept in a weird position.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's raining again... I'm fed up with rain.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope the weather's nicer when my family comes to visit.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If it doesn't clear up, I won't see the stars tonight, either.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wonder how everyone's doing. I wonder if they're having fun with their classmates...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I miss them so much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ngh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?
This isn't a hospital bed...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
I'm all better now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can see everyone again...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Saki! Are you not ready yet?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: It's good that you've been putting so much effort into getting ready for the day each morning, but if you take too long, you'll be late!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What? It's morning?
Wh-What time is it?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no... I overslept!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
I... I made it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was close. If Tsukasa didn't wake me up, I definitely would've been late for classes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Morning, Saki.
Glad you made it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're not the type to oversleep in the mornings, so I was surprised when you messaged me. Did you stay up too late?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, but I guess I was so caught up in my dream that I couldn't wake up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What sort of dream?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well... It was, um...

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Tenma, Hoshino...
The teacher's coming.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Thanks for the heads up!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come on, Ichi! We should return to our seats!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (She'd feel bad if I told her that I was dreaming about when I was in the hospital.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (The hospital was too far for her to visit me often and I think it made her feel guilty.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I don't want to cause my friends any more worries now that I've gotten better.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Let's make the most of this day!)
After school

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay, time to close the textbooks and head off to practice!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
You're really hyped today, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess so! I almost started off by running late today, but it's all good now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Besides, we're meeting in you-know-where today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's right. It's been a while since we last went, so I'm looking forward to it too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hi, Saki. Hi, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Honami! You made it through the day, so...
Lemme give you a hug!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Aaah! Careful, Saki.
You almost made me fall over...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't cause a scene in the corridor.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho! Don't you worry, I've got a hug for you too! Come here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, cut it out. We've got important plans today, so let's find somewhere more private.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, maybe you shouldn't be pinching Saki's cheeks like that. Her face just looks... Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha! Saki, you should see yourself!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I pwomise I won't twy to hug you anymwore, fo let gwo of my sheeks!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Looks like no one's around.
Are you all ready?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay... Here we go!
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome back!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. We've been waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Miku! Luka!
Thanks for having us!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Always happy to.
I see you're full of pep as always, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And yet, this morning she surprised us by almost turning up late for classes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What, really?
That's pretty unusual.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You always come to school so early.
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe... I fell back asleep right after waking up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Haha, THAT is just like you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyways, enough about that. I can't wait to show the fruits of our labor to Miku and Luka!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, let's get ready to play.

rows.Speaker: Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That dream really startled me, but I'm fine now.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(I'm no longer all alone.
I'm with my friends.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I have to make up for the time I lost from here on out!)
